Overview:
This steel-plate weight‑loading equipment is specifically designed for fitness and body shaping. Featuring a durable steel core, it can be used with wrist straps, ankle cuffs, and weighted vests. Its breathable, adjustable design ensures comfort and stability during exercise, making it suitable for running and a variety of training scenarios to help users efficiently increase their workout intensity.
